meta.title: Kouki Web | Custom websites and systems
meta.description: Custom websites and systems for small and mid-sized businesses. A fixed quote before I start, with hosting, maintenance and security included.

hero.title: Custom websites and systems
hero.lead: I build websites and systems for small and mid-sized businesses, and look after them once they’re live.

demo.includedFooter: A fixed quote before I start.

statement: One professional, from the first conversation to keeping your site running.

typeAndSee.title: Your business in many languages
typeAndSee.hint: Your site in any language, and as many as you need. These are just a few examples.

items.title: Custom design
items.text: Your website built from scratch, with its own identity and a structure designed around your business.

items.title: Custom systems
items.text: Dashboards, automations and order management designed around how your company works.

items.title: Admin panel
items.text: Update products and content from your computer or phone, without depending on anyone.

items.title: New website
items.text: Starting out or rebuilding your site? I build it from scratch, with a fixed quote before I start.

items.title: Custom system
items.text: Spreadsheets and repetitive tasks eating your time? I build a system or automation around how you work.

items.title: Website upgrade
items.text: Already have a site that’s slow, outdated or hard to edit? I improve what you already have.

items.title: Understand
items.text: You tell me what you need. I listen, answer your questions and suggest what makes sense.

items.title: Build
items.text: With the quote agreed, I design and build your website or system.

items.title: Launch
items.text: I put everything live, with domain, hosting and security set up.

items.title: Evolve
items.text: Once it’s live, I handle maintenance and any adjustments and improvements that come up.

items.question: How long does it take?
items.answer: It depends on the size of the project. Tell me what you need and I’ll give you an estimate.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: Every project is different, so I send a fixed quote before I start.

items.question: What is included?
items.answer: In every project: domain, hosting, database, maintenance, security, speed and accessibility.

items.question: Which languages can my site be in?
items.answer: Any language, and as many as you need. The four on this site are just examples.

contact.title: Tell me what you need and get a quote
contact.message: Hi! I came from your website and would like a quote.

footer.text: Custom websites and systems for small and mid-sized businesses.
